findings.message:
[P2] Keep partial Codex rows eligible for Check shown

When the Codex tier is narrowed to one subscription and filtered as the only visible row, `isProviderChecked("codex")` returns true for the partial row, making `visibleChecked === visibleCount` and disabling `providersCheckAllBtn`. The bulk handler would otherwise call `setProviderChecked("codex", true)` to expand the partial selection to all subscriptions, so use a full-selection count for the check button while retaining the active-row count for uncheck.

static/admin.js:10053-10053

summary: The requested uncheck behavior is implemented, but the shared count disables “Check shown” for a partial Codex selection.

evidence: static/admin.js:10053 now uses isProviderChecked(id), whose Codex branch returns true when a configured subscription id is selected.
tests/admin-models-catalog.test.ts:813-832 constructs a Codex roster with one selected subscription and a visible Codex id, then asserts the uncheck-disabled condition is false.
